why.title: Why now
why.1.d: Every password reset is support time and drop-off. Passkeys cut the loop to a device prompt.
why.2.d: WebAuthn binds credentials to your RP ID. Stolen passwords stop being the default breach path.
why.3.d: iOS, Android, and desktop browsers already teach Face ID / fingerprint / security keys.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.1.a: No. PassGate is implementation help and a template. It does not certify your product. Responsibility boundaries are written into the order.
faq.2.q: What if my repo access is delayed?
faq.2.a: The 48h clock starts when we have agreed access and a signed-off stack questionnaire. Waiting time is marked on the ticket.
faq.3.q: Do you support Safari autofill quirks?
faq.3.a: Yes inside the web matrix in TEST_PLAN. Native app SDKs are out of scope.
faq.4.q: Can I upgrade from template to install?
faq.4.a: Yes. Template buyers can book install; we credit conversation time, not the $49, unless stated in a promo.
faq.5.a: Template: digital goods, refund only if ZIP fails to download within 24h and we cannot repair. Install: if we miss the 48h delivery window for reasons on us, 50% refund of the install fee.
disc.title: Disclaimer
disc.body: PassGate does not provide a security audit, penetration test, or compliance certification (SOC2, ISO, etc.). You remain responsible for production configuration, RP ID, secret handling, and release decisions. Orders document In/Out scope.
